bundle.shortDescription: Coding agents on one project, in rounds
bundle.longDescription:
Ilvuno runs several coding agents on one project, in rounds, until a goal is met.
You write the goal and say what finished looks like. The agents work in threads, write
what they found to a shared board, and nothing lands until you accept it at the gate.
This package holds the window, the ilvuno command, and ilvunod, the local runner.
